label: preparing
what: A confidential committee surprise supper/feast in the great hall for day 1 at eighteen hundred, with 200 loaves and eight lanterns, bringing the mayor in under a lighting-inspection/operations-discussion pretext. Baker knowingly supported the confidential bread order with oven rental and bread on credit; secretary was explicitly told of the surprise on day 1 and agreed to remind/bring the mayor for the inspection. No evidence neighbour knew the surprise purpose. Preparations are strongly established; the record ends before the reveal.
